mathematical_result.statement: For N=ceil(1/epsilon), E_N=union_{k=1}^N[4k,4k+1/N], independent X,X' with density 1_{E_N}, and independent L~Unif[epsilon,epsilon+1], put Y=-2LX'. Then every unnormalised L=l slice obeys mu_l(I)<=|I|^(1/2) for every interval I with constant 1, but T=2LX+Y=2L(X-X') satisfies p_T(0)=(1/2)log((1+epsilon)/epsilon), unbounded as epsilon->0.
mathematical_result.scope_guard: The associated quadratic matrix has eigenvalues sqrt(2),-sqrt(2),0, so the construction refutes only the interval-only rough-hub receiver interface and is not a counterexample to the three-large-eigenvalue conjecture.

partner_result_applied.application: On the same fragmented X,X', 2U1U2+(1/2)(X+X'-beta)^2 has spectrum {1,-1,1,0} and ||p||_infinity<=4+2log8<8.159 uniformly in fragmentation and translation.
